I would like to thank my supervisor, Beatrice Taylor, for her guidance and support throughout this dissertation. Her comments on the research design, methods and writing helped me keep the analysis focused and present the work more clearly.

I am also grateful to the organisations and data providers that make financial, satellite and shipping data openly available. This research would not have been possible without these public resources.

Finally, I thank those who stood by me this year, and the home that let me watch the London sunset every evening.
